steps.en: Stored owner, hirer and driver data is loaded
steps.id: Data owner, hirer, dan driver yang tersimpan dimuat

steps.en: Existing data is checked for that role only
steps.id: Data yang ada dicek hanya untuk role itu
steps.why_en: Only the same role is checked; the all-roles check is not connected to the screen.
steps.why_id: Hanya role yang sama dicek; cek semua role tidak terhubung ke layar.

steps.en: A prompt appears when data already exists
steps.id: Prompt muncul jika data sudah ada

steps.en: Existing details are visible on screen
steps.id: Detail yang ada terlihat di layar
steps.why_en: Shown in the form behind the prompt, not inside the prompt itself.
steps.why_id: Tampil di form di balik prompt, bukan di dalam prompt.
